## Type of change

## Affected areas

- [ ] Agent (`agent/`)
- [ ] Server (`server/`)
- [ ] Dashboard (`dashboard/`)

## Checklist

- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] The relevant tests pass locally (`npm test` for server, `npm run build` for dashboard, `cargo test` for agent).
- [ ] Lint/typecheck is clean (TypeScript `strict`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`).
- [ ] I added or updated tests for my changes where appropriate.
- [ ] I updated documentation (README / docs) where needed.
- [ ] CI passes (`server`, `dashboard`, `agent` checks are green).
- [ ] This PR does not introduce covert or undisclosed monitoring behavior (openv360 is transparent by design).
